title: David Choe Went Baboon Hunting with the Hadza People of Tanzania
description: Choe gives a longer account of living and hunting with the Hadza: elders' stories, children handling animals, endurance, scarce water, injured hunting dogs and his own collapse after trying to prove useful on a baboon hunt.
